title: Budget Burn Rate Above Plan
app: Monarch Money, Copilot Money, Plaid-connected accounts, Plaid investments, and brokerage CSV exports ingested into Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=monarch:transaction
| stats sum(amount_usd) as spent_usd, latest(monthly_budget_usd) as monthly_budget_usd by category
| eval burn_pct=round(100*spent_usd/monthly_budget_usd,1)
| where monthly_budget_usd>0 AND burn_pct>85
| sort - burn_pct
description: Uses Monarch category spend telemetry to monitor which categories have burned through most of the month's budget in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for budget lines likely to end the month in the red, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Monarch category spend data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Category table of budget burn percentage.
grandmaExplanation: It nudges which categories have burned through most of the month's budget so you can spot budget lines likely to end the month in the red before it becomes annoying.
